```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/satavans/Downloads/non_aug_data.csv")
df
```

```{r}
df_analyze <- df %>%
  filter(Subject == 5,Sample == 1, Drive == 1)


ggplot(df_analyze, aes(X,LPupil_Diameter)) +
  geom_line()

ggplot(df_analyze, aes(X,RPupil_Diameter)) +
  geom_line()

df_injection <- df_analyze %>%
  mutate(Blink = ifelse(LPupil_Diameter == 0 & RPupil_Diameter == 0, 1,0)) %>%
  mutate(LPupil_Diameter = ifelse(lag(Blink) == 1 | lead(Blink) == 1, 0,LPupil_Diameter),
         RPupil_Diameter = ifelse(lag(Blink) == 1 | lead(Blink) == 1, 0,RPupil_Diameter))

ggplot(df_injection, aes(X,LPupil_Diameter)) +
  geom_line()

ggplot(df_injection, aes(X,RPupil_Diameter)) +
  geom_line()
  
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_analyze, aes(X,Left_Gaze_Dir_X)) +
  geom_line()

ggplot(df_analyze, aes(X,Right_Gaze_Dir_X)) +
  geom_line()
```
